start: Today, signed in as owner; a member complaint came 10 minutes ago and nobody has handled it

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: Card titled 'Latest from your members'
One line: the server's own line about the complaint, then '10 min ago'
An urgent line that still waits is in bold
must_not: A conversation already marked done, or a request already decided, is listed
A line older than 24 hours is listed
More than 5 lines

steps.action: Tap the line
user_sees: The panel opens Member messages on Complaints
must_not: Another page opens
The line counts as done only because it was opened

steps.action: In that page reply to it or mark the conversation done, then go back to Today
user_sees: The line is gone from the card
When no line is left the whole card is gone (no heading)
The bell still keeps the line, marked 'Done'
must_not: The handled line still sits on Today
A line that still needs someone is hidden by a guess
The bell loses the line

start: Today, signed in as owner; nothing from members waits (or everything was handled)

steps.action: Open Today
user_sees: No 'Latest from your members' card at all; the rest of Today as usual
must_not: An empty card with only the heading
An error or a spinner in its place

steps.action: Open Today while an alert's own list (messages, questions, requests) has not been read since the alert came
user_sees: The line stays on Today until the panel can tell it was handled
must_not: The line is hidden although nobody handled it

steps.action: Tap a line whose address the server sent in a form the panel does not accept
user_sees: The panel stays on Today (the safe address)
must_not: A blank page
An address outside the panel opens

start: Today, signed in as owner; one news line (a member joined) and one line that needs someone

steps.action: Open Today and read the card
user_sees: Both lines are shown; the news line stays while this visit to Today lasts
must_not: The news line vanishes while the person is still reading

steps.action: Open another page, then come back to Today
user_sees: The news line is gone (it was shown once)
The line that needs someone is still there
must_not: The news line shows again on every visit
The line that needs someone is gone though nobody handled it

steps.action: Open the bell and take the waiting line off the list with the X, then look at Today
user_sees: The line is still on Today: it is not done
must_not: Removing it from the bell takes it off Today

steps.action: Someone else at the gym handles it on another device; wait a minute on Today
user_sees: The line leaves Today without a reload
must_not: The line stays until the browser is reloaded
The whole page jumps when the list is read again

start: The panel is open on any page, signed in as owner, browser alerts allowed; a new alert arrives (the ring, not the card)

steps.action: Sign in and wait for the first answer from the server
user_sees: No ring and no browser notice for alerts that were already there
must_not: Opening the panel rings for old alerts

steps.action: One new alert comes while the panel is open
user_sees: A browser notice titled 'MettleUp: news from your members' with the alert's own line
must_not: The same alert rings twice
The notice opens a page other than the one the line names

steps.action: Three new alerts come in one look
user_sees: One notice: '3 new updates from your members. Open Today to see them.'
must_not: Three separate notices
A count that does not match the new lines

steps.action: Tap the notice
user_sees: The panel opens Today (or the page of the single alert)
must_not: A second copy of the panel opens on a wrong page

start: Today, signed in as owner; another kind of line: a shop order, then an online payment

steps.action: A member orders from the shop; open Today
user_sees: 'New shop order #12 from <name>. Get it ready on Shop.' in bold
must_not: The order number without '#'
A line that disagrees with Shop today

steps.action: On Shop mark the order ready, go back to Today
user_sees: The order line is gone from Today (ready needs nothing more)
must_not: 'Get it ready' still shown for an order that is ready

steps.action: A member pays online; open Today
user_sees: The line has its own colour and a small 'Payment' label
must_not: A payment line that looks like any other line
A failed payment shown in the paid colour

start: Today on the owner device; a member sent a complaint and picked the gym admin

steps.action: Open Today as owner
user_sees: The complaint line is shown, with the first name only as the server wrote it
must_not: The complaint text itself on Today
A phone number in the line

steps.action: Tap it
user_sees: Member messages opens on Complaints
must_not: It opens on Feedback or Questions

steps.action: Sign in on the same browser as front desk and open Today
user_sees: No complaint line, and no ring for it
must_not: The desk sees or hears the complaint
